items.title: 13.8.2 Silver halides (AgX) ka aabi ammonia se reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.8.2 with Table 13.6 and Quick Check 13.4, printed pages 298-299.

blocks.text: Aqueous ammonia dal kar dekha jata hai ke pehle bane silver halide precipitates hal (dissolve) hote hain ya nahi.

AgF pani mein hal ho jata hai, is liye is ka precipitate banta hi nahi aur ammonia ka koi asar nahi hota. Silver chloride dilute ammonia mein hal ho kar diamminesilver(I) complex [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ banata hai; AgCl ka safed precipitate dilute ammonia mein hal ho kar be-rang solution deta hai. (Kitab ne “diamminesilver(1)” chhapa hai; sahi likhai Roman numeral ke saath diamminesilver(I) hai.)
AgBr ka cream rang ka precipitate concentrated ammonia mein hal ho kar be-rang solution deta hai.
Silver iodide (AgI) ka peela precipitate na dilute ammonia mein hal hota hai na concentrated mein, is liye ammonia dalne se koi tabdeeli nahi hoti.
Table 13.6 mein diya gaya silsila aqueous silver ions aur ammonia ke saath solubility ki madad se halide ions ko ek ek kar ke pehchanne ka systematic (ba-qaida) tareeqa hai.

rows: aq. NH₃ se koi reaction nahi

blocks.prompt: a) F⁻ Cl⁻ se kamzor reducing agent kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluorine sab se zyada electronegative hai aur F⁻ ion bohat chhota hai, is liye is ka izafi electron nucleus ke qareeb mazbooti se pakra hota hai (charge density zyada). Cl⁻ bara hai aur chlorine kam electronegative hai, is liye is ka electron aasani se diya ja sakta hai; is liye Cl⁻ behtar reducing agent hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Silver halides ki ammonia mein solubility mukhtalif kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia Ag⁺ ke saath [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ complex bana kar precipitate ko hal karti hai. AgCl teenon mein sab se zyada soluble hai, is liye dilute ammonia kaafi hai. AgBr kam soluble hai, is ke liye concentrated ammonia chahiye. AgI itna kam soluble hai ke ammonia solution mein kaafi Ag⁺ nahi kheench sakti, is liye yeh hal nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: c) KI ke Ag⁺ aur phir NH₃ ke saath reaction ki equation likhein. Aakhir mein kya nazar aayega?
blocks.explanation: KI(aq) + AgNO₃(aq) → AgI(s) + KNO₃(aq), yani Ag⁺(aq) + I⁻(aq) → AgI(s): halka peela precipitate banta hai. Phir ammonia (dilute ho ya concentrated) dalne par kuch nahi badalta; peela precipitate waise hi rehta hai.

items: AgCl dilute NH₃ mein, AgBr concentrated NH₃ mein hal hota hai; dono be-rang [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ dete hain.
AgI kisi ammonia mein hal nahi hota; AgF ka precipitate banta hi nahi.
